他的声音很轻，助理没听到：“什么？”韩经年意识到自己失态了，回神：“没什么。”三秒后，他又开了口：“回家。”助理又迷糊了，不过没等助理开口，韩经年就想到什么一样，又补了句：“她在的那个家。”…做完spa，已是午夜一点钟。夏晚安不会开车，成年就拿到驾驶证的宋有蔓送她回的家。一路上，宋有蔓一心二用的边开车，还边苦口婆心的劝夏晚安早点脱离韩经年那个苦海。和宋有蔓分开后，夏晚安目送着她车子不见了踪影后，才进了电梯。很晚了，电梯里只有夏晚安一人，寂静狭隘的空间里，夏晚安盯着不断跳动的红色数字，突然想到了宋有蔓的那句“早点脱离韩经年这个苦海”。苦海……可不，还真是苦海……偷偷地喜欢一个人，总是苦的，至于脱离……若是能脱离，那就好了……她比谁都希望自己不要那么那么那么的喜欢他。很快，电梯抵达了所在的楼层。从电梯出来，夏晚安一气呵成的输入密码，推开门，然后惯性的抬起手去开灯时，这才发现，室内的灯，明灿灿的亮着。她记得她关了灯呀……夏晚安愣了愣，低头，看见一双黑色的皮鞋摆在玄关处的鞋柜前。那皮鞋很眼熟，就是今晚韩经年穿的那一双……所以，他回来了？正在夏晚安错愕之际，书房的门被推开，身上还穿着晚上那身西装的韩经年，从里面走了出来。忽的看到韩经年，夏晚安略有些无措，为了掩饰自己的慌张，她下意识的开了口，“你怎么回来了？”伴随着话音从嘴边落定，夏晚安敏锐的捕捉到韩经年微微蹙起的眉心，她这才后知后觉的反应过来自己说错了话。这是他的家，他怎么就不能回来了……想着，夏晚安就急忙又动了唇，“我的意思是，我以为你有约，不回来了呢，所以有点诧异。”她的声音温温软软的，和平时没什么区别，情绪也拿捏得很好，让人听不出丝毫端倪，可她的心底，在说出“有约”那两个字时，清晰地泛起了浓浓的酸楚和微微的刺痛。韩经年没着急开口，他望着夏晚安的眼底漆黑深邃，让人根本摸不透他在想些什么，可他的眼神却又很有穿透力，仿佛能透过对方的眼睛看透人心。不过短短的十几秒钟，夏晚安就垂头，避开了韩经年的视线。她刚想找个借口，将此时的尴尬掩盖过去，只是她还没开口，站在不远处的他，语调凉淡的出了声：“拿文件。”听他这么说，夏晚安才注意到他手里多了一个文件夹。原来他只是回来拿东西呀……幸好她刚刚没因为看到他在家，产生过多的别的想法……夏晚安很想问他一句，那你还要走吗？可话到嘴边，却又被她生生的压了下去。他和她之间……好像还没熟络到她有资格问他行踪的地步……

His voice was so soft that the assistant didn't hear him: "What?" Han Jingnian realized that he had lost his composure and came back to his senses: "It's nothing." Three seconds later, he spoke again: "Go home." The assistant was confused again, but before the assistant could speak, Han Jingnian thought of something and added: "The home where she is." After finishing the spa, it was already one o'clock at midnight. Xia Wan'an couldn't drive, so Song Youman, who had obtained a driver's license as an adult, sent her home. Along the way, Song Youman was driving while trying to persuade Xia Good Night to get out of Han Jingnian's misery as soon as possible. After separating from Song Youman, Xia Wanan watched her car disappear before entering the elevator. It was very late, and Xia Wan'an was the only one in the elevator. In the quiet and narrow space, Xia Wan'an stared at the constantly beating red numbers, and suddenly thought of Song Youman's words, "Get out of Han Jingnian's sea of ​​misery as soon as possible." The sea of ​​suffering... No, it is really the sea of ​​suffering... It is always painful to like someone secretly. As for getting out of it... It would be great if you can get away from it... She hopes more than anyone else that she doesn't like him so much. Soon, the elevator arrived at the floor. After coming out of the elevator, Xia Wan'an entered the password in one breath, opened the door, and then raised her hand to turn on the light with inertia. Only then did she realize that the indoor light was brightly on. She remembered that she turned off the light... Xia Wan'an was stunned. She lowered her head and saw a pair of black leather shoes placed in front of the shoe cabinet in the entrance hall. Those leather shoes look familiar, the same pair Han Jingnian is wearing tonight... So, he is back? When Xia Wan'an was stunned, the door of the study room was pushed open, and Han Jingnian, still wearing the suit he wore that night, walked out. Suddenly seeing Han Jingnian, Xia Wan'an was a little at a loss. In order to cover up her panic, she subconsciously said, "Why are you back?" As the words settled from her mouth, Xia Wan'an keenly caught Han Jingnian's slightly frowning eyebrows. Only then did she realize that she had said the wrong thing. This is his home, why can't he come back... Thinking about it, Xia Wan'an hurriedly moved her lips again, "I mean, I thought you had an appointment and you didn't come back, so I was a little surprised." Her voice was gentle and soft, no different from usual, and her emotions were well controlled, making it impossible to hear the slightest clue. But deep in her heart, when she said the two words "I have an appointment," there was clear sadness and a slight sting. Han Jingnian didn't speak in a hurry. He looked at Xia Wan'an with dark and deep eyes that made it impossible to tell what he was thinking, but his eyes were very penetrating, as if he could see through the other person's eyes. However, in just ten seconds, Xia Wan'an lowered his head and avoided Han Jingnian's sight. She was just about to find an excuse to cover up her embarrassment, but before she spoke, he, standing not far away, said in a cool tone: "Get the file." After hearing what he said, Xia Wan'an noticed that there was an extra folder in his hand. It turns out that he just came back to get something... Fortunately, she didn't have too many other thoughts just because she saw him at home... Xia Wan'an really wanted to ask him, do you still want to leave? But when the words came to her lips, she suppressed them. He and her... didn't seem to know each other well enough for her to ask about his whereabouts...
